slides.headline: SNAP YOUR FRIDGE. AI PLANS *3 LEFTOVER MEALS.*
slides.sub: Turn tonight's Thanksgiving leftovers into dinners for the week. The free ChatGPT plan works.

slides.headline: HOW TO DO IT IN *3 TAPS*
steps: Open your fridge and take one clear photo of the leftovers
In ChatGPT, tap + then "Add photos & files"
Paste the prompt on the next slide and send
slides.note: Image uploads work on the Free plan (limits apply). The prompt is next...

slides.headline: COPY THIS *PROMPT*
lines: Here's a photo of my leftovers.
- List anything I need to buy
slides.note: Works the same in Gemini or Claude. Change the [numbers] to fit your family.

slides.headline: WATCH OUT: *THE 2-HOUR RULE*
slides.body: USDA: refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. They keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge or 3 to 4 months frozen. Reheat to 165°F.
slides.note: AI can't see if food is safe. Trust the date, not the chatbot. Source: USDA FSIS, "Leftovers and Food Safety"

slides.headline: BONUS: *NO TURKEY SANDWICH #5*
slides.body: Reply "make one of them a soup and one freezer-friendly" and it rewrites the plan. Turkey eaten by Monday, the rest frozen.
slides.note: Last swipe: who to send this to...

slides.text: SEND THIS TO WHOEVER'S TAKING *THE LEFTOVERS HOME*
